_doc: How the player's tools step and reach (game/tools), interaction choices of this game with no norm behind them. drawn_px: the width of an outline a tool draws (a lot, a demolition), screen pixels. brush: between dabs along a stroke a share of the radius (step_share) and never closer than step_least_m; a pointer back from far away lays at most most_steps dabs at once. handle: a building handle turns in turn_steps steps a turn (Shift free). building: R turns the model in hand by a turn in turn_steps (Shift: tuning build_gear_turn_deg). lots: what of a corner or a side the pointer takes (take_px, screen pixels); how far a lot's point reaches for a footway or a corner (catch_px at this zoom, never less than snap_least_m); the marks' size (mark_m). road: the height keys and buttons step the road in hand by height_step_m, landing on whole steps. roundabout: [ and ] scale by scale_step. terrain: one dab per dab_s held, which keeps each step above the 1 cm height quantum. zone: a drag is sampled every step_m metres (shorter than any lot's front), the whole way, up to most_dabs at a report; the zone a stroke paints when none was chosen (default_zone, a zones.json id).

handle._doc: arrow_back: an arrow's barbs reach back this share of its length; chevron: the roof's chevron this share of its width (render/handle_marks.gd).

inspector._doc: The Inspector's road panel (ui/road_panel.gd): an end raised by raise_by_m; a curve's depth between curve_least_m and curve_most_m, at most curve_share of the road's length, straight under curve_straight_m, stepped by curve_step_m; where along it the curve stands, from curve_from to curve_to in steps of at_step.

profile_editor._doc: The road profile editor (ui/road_profile_panel.gd): an element widened by widen_by_m; the speed limit stepped by pace_by_kmh between speed_least_kmh and speed_most_kmh.

split._doc: The split tool (game/tools/split_tool.gd): the mark where a road will be cut is mark_share of its half width.

model_studio._doc: The Models shelf's studio (render/model_studio.gd), by eye: a picture picture_px square, the body framed with frame_margin round it, the camera camera_reach_m out; the sun at light_angles_deg (x, y, z degrees) with light_gain, the ambient ambient_energy.

reference_model._doc: A reference 3D model over the city (render/reference_model.gd): its pictures px_per_m pixels a metre, at most picture_cap_px and at least picture_floor_px a side, read reach_pad_m past its box; its opacity stepped by opacity_grain, never under least_opacity.
